# Subromart

> Subromart provides software development, configurable business solutions and ongoing maintenance. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with Bengali and English website content.

## Identity

- Website: https://subromart.com/
- Founder and CEO: Subroto Das
- Founder at Subromart: https://subromart.com/subroto-das/
- Professional portfolio and contact source: https://me.subromart.com/
- Engineering learning resource: https://systems.subromart.com/
- Email: subrotodas1714037@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8801521409155

Subromart (subromart.com) is distinct from other similarly spelled brands. Systems Hub is the founder's personal engineering learning platform; it is not a customer login portal.

## Solutions

- [CampusOS: School Management](https://subromart.com/solutions/school-management/): Bring admissions, attendance, fees, exams and parent communication into a single, easy-to-use school management system.
- [LearnOS: EdTech & LMS](https://subromart.com/solutions/edtech/): Create your own learning platform with courses, video lessons, assessments, payments and a dedicated learner experience.
- [CareOS: Healthcare Management](https://subromart.com/solutions/healthcare/): Connect appointments, patient records, billing and clinic operations with software designed around your care workflow.
- [CommerceOS: E-commerce & Retail](https://subromart.com/solutions/ecommerce/): Sell through a responsive storefront with connected products, inventory, orders, payments and delivery workflows.
- [BusinessOS: Business ERP & Inventory](https://subromart.com/solutions/business-erp/): Connect purchasing, inventory, sales, expenses and reporting in a business system that follows your operations.
- [ConnectOS: CRM & Sales Operations](https://subromart.com/solutions/crm/): Give your sales and support teams one place for leads, conversations, follow-ups, proposals and customer history.
- [TableOS: Restaurant & POS](https://subromart.com/solutions/restaurant/): Manage menus, table orders, kitchen tickets, billing and stock with software built for your restaurant workflow.
- [PeopleOS: HR & Payroll](https://subromart.com/solutions/hr-payroll/): Organise employee records, attendance, leave requests, payroll preparation and staff self-service in one place.

## Services

- [Custom software development](https://subromart.com/services/custom-software/): From the first workflow sketch to a working product, we build software around your people, processes and goals.
- [Website & web applications](https://subromart.com/services/web-development/): Fast, responsive websites and web platforms that make it easier for your customers to understand, trust and work with you.
- [Mobile app development](https://subromart.com/services/mobile-apps/): Purposeful Android and iOS experiences with connected APIs, clear navigation and the features your users actually need.
- [Frontend development](https://subromart.com/services/frontend/): Turn designs into fast, accessible interfaces that work beautifully on mobile, tablet and desktop.
- [Backend & API engineering](https://subromart.com/services/backend-api/): Connect your products with well-structured APIs, clear permissions, reliable data flows and maintainable backend systems.
- [UI/UX & product design](https://subromart.com/services/ui-ux/): Research, user journeys and practical prototypes that help you make clearer product decisions before development begins.
- [Maintenance & managed support](https://subromart.com/services/maintenance/): Keep your software cared for after launch with agreed monitoring, updates, backups, fixes and ongoing improvements.
- [Cloud & deployment](https://subromart.com/services/cloud-devops/): Practical hosting, deployment pipelines and operational visibility for your web applications and backend services.
- [Integrations & automation](https://subromart.com/services/integrations/): Connect payments, messaging, internal tools and external services so your team spends less time moving data by hand.

## Factual boundaries

Solution dashboards use illustrative sample data, not real customer records. Scope, availability, price, licensing, support coverage and delivery dates are agreed in a written proposal. The work section attributes the founder's professional experience and engineering resources; employer projects are not advertised as Subromart client commissions or products for resale. There is no online checkout. Contact forms prepare a message locally, then let the visitor choose to send through WhatsApp or email.

## Languages

English is the default at / and Bengali is available at /bn/. Both language versions are static HTML with canonical and hreflang links. Feature and setup details use native HTML details elements: visitors can expand them, and the full text is present in the original HTML.

## Client Care — Scope, Handover & Support
URL: https://subromart.com/client-care/

WORK WITH CONFIDENCE Know what you’re getting. Four conversations before a project begins. Each one belongs in your written proposal. Download the checklist Meet Subroto Das 01 Scope & total cost Included features, exclusions, milestones and third-party fees. What to confirm What will the first release include? List the price, payment milestones, hosting and recurring service costs. Agree how changes will be estimated before they are built. 02 Progress you can review An agreed demo and acceptance checklist for each milestone. What to confirm Choose who reviews each milestone, the workflows to demonstrate and the checks needed for acceptance. Record feedback and resolve the agreed issues before signing off. 03 Ownership & handover Know which accounts, licences, files and documentation you receive. What to confirm Document who owns the domain, hosting, application accounts and business data. Specify source-code rights, third-party licences, data export, training and the handover format in your proposal. 04 Support after launch Agree contacts, coverage, response targets and ongoing costs. What to confirm Separate bug fixes from new features. Agree support hours, response targets, maintenance fees, backup responsibilities and how access is transferred if the engagement ends. Coverage follows the written plan. Use this as a discussion checklist. The agreed proposal defines your deliverables, rights and support. MAKE AN INFORMED CHOICE See the people. Explore the product. Founder & public profiles Request a guided demo START A PROJECT Let’s build your next system. Talk to us Project planner

## Projects, pricing & support: your questions
URL: https://subromart.com/faq/

THE DETAILS THAT MATTER Your questions, answered. Pricing, ownership, delivery and support. 01 Can you build something specific to my business? Yes. We start by understanding your workflow, users and priorities, then propose a suitable scope. You can choose a configured solution, a fully custom product or a phased approach. 02 How much does a project cost? Pricing depends on features, integrations, design, data migration and ongoing support. After a discovery conversation, you receive a written scope and quote. Third-party subscriptions and hosting are identified separately. 03 Can I see a demo before deciding? Yes. Explore the interactive previews here, then request a guided demo around your requirements. On-site previews use illustrative data; final screens and features depend on your agreed project scope. 04 Do you maintain software after launch? Yes. We can agree a maintenance plan covering updates, monitoring, backups, bug fixes and improvements. Support hours, response targets and exclusions are defined in your agreement. 05 Will the software work on mobile devices? Responsive web interfaces are planned for mobile, tablet and desktop. Dedicated Android and iOS apps can be included when needed. Hardware-specific and offline requirements are evaluated separately. 06 Who owns the code and data? Ownership, licensing, access and handover are stated in the proposal and contract. Custom software and configured products may have different licensing terms. We discuss this before work starts. 07 Can you improve or take over an existing system? We can review your existing codebase, infrastructure and documentation first. The review determines what can be maintained, what needs to change and how to transition safely. 08 Can we work together remotely? Yes. Discovery, reviews and handover can happen remotely. We agree communication channels, meeting times and milestones for your time zone before the project begins. 09 How long does development take? The timeline follows the agreed scope, content readiness and integration requirements. We share a phased schedule after discovery and make dependencies and review deadlines clear. 10 Can the interface support Bengali and English? Yes. We can plan bilingual interfaces, content and locale-aware formatting. The exact translation and content responsibilities are agreed with your team. START A PROJECT Let’s build your next system. Talk to us Project planner

## Privacy & your information
URL: https://subromart.com/privacy/

CLEAR BY DESIGN Privacy & your information How this website handles contact details, local preferences and third-party links. On this page What this website stores Contact forms and project briefs Third-party websites Hosting and requests Questions about your information Contact us ↗ What this website stores Your display mode, accent colour, reduced-motion preference, comparison selection and floating-button position may be saved in your browser’s local storage. These preferences stay on your device and can be reset through appearance settings or your browser settings. Contact forms and project briefs The contact form prepares a message in your browser. It does not send your details to a Subromart server. When you choose WhatsApp or email, your chosen app opens with the information you entered. Review the message before sending it. Details sent to us may be used to discuss and respond to your enquiry. Third-party websites Links to WhatsApp, social profiles, the founder’s portfolio and Systems Hub open external services. Their own privacy practices apply when you visit them. Fonts and visual assets on this website are served locally. This version does not include advertising trackers or third-party analytics scripts. Hosting and requests When deployed, the hosting provider may process normal request information such as IP address, requested page and browser details for delivery and security. The retention and location of those logs depend on the selected hosting provider. Questions about your information For questions about information you have shared with Subromart, contact subrotodas1714037@gmail.com. Do not submit passwords, medical records, financial credentials or other sensitive records through project enquiry messages.

## Website terms
URL: https://subromart.com/terms/

CLEAR BY DESIGN Website terms Information about website content, demonstrations, project proposals and third-party services. On this page About the information here Proposals and agreements Portfolio attribution External services and outcomes Contact us ↗ About the information here This website presents Subromart’s software and development services. Product names and interface previews describe solution concepts and possible modules. Preview data is illustrative. Availability, deliverables and final features are established in a written proposal. Proposals and agreements Contacting us or requesting a demo does not create a purchase or booking. Project scope, pricing, payment milestones, licensing, ownership and support responsibilities must be agreed separately in writing before work begins. Portfolio attribution The work section includes the founder’s professional experience and engineering walkthroughs. Named employers, platforms and third-party projects are not presented as Subromart customers or products for resale. Their names and marks belong to their respective owners. External services and outcomes External links, app-store reviews, payment accounts, hosting and search-engine inclusion depend on their respective providers. Search rankings, commercial outcomes and third-party approvals are not guaranteed by this website.

## Designed to be easier to use
URL: https://subromart.com/accessibility/

CLEAR BY DESIGN Designed to be easier to use Keyboard navigation, readable content, display preferences and accessibility support on Subromart. On this page Navigation and reading Your display preferences Keyboard controls Report a problem Contact us ↗ Navigation and reading This site uses semantic headings, labelled controls, a skip-to-content link and visible keyboard focus. Most content and all page links work without JavaScript. Interactive tools use JavaScript for previews, search, comparison and message preparation. Your display preferences Choose light, dark or device-auto display mode. Adjust the accent colour and reduce animation in appearance settings. Device reduced-motion settings are respected. Content supports browser zoom and layouts adapt to small screens. Keyboard controls Use Tab to move between controls and Enter or Space to activate buttons. Escape closes dialogs. The WhatsApp button can be repositioned with Shift plus the arrow keys when focused, or reset from appearance settings. Report a problem If something makes the site difficult to use, email subrotodas1714037@gmail.com with the page address, the task you were trying to complete and your device or assistive technology. We welcome specific feedback and do not claim universal accessibility conformance.

## How to choose software that fits your business
URL: https://subromart.com/resources/choosing-software/

Buying guide How to choose software that fits your business A practical checklist for features, ownership, integrations and long-term support. Subromart editorial Meet our founder 1 min read In this guide Start with the workflow, not the feature list Ask to see your own use case Understand the full cost of ownership Agree on ownership and exit Start with the workflow, not the feature list Write down the work that takes your team the most time. Who performs it? What information do they need? Which mistakes happen repeatedly? A useful software shortlist starts with these answers, then maps each workflow to a feature. Separate must-haves from improvements you can add later. Ask to see your own use case A polished demo is a starting point. Ask the provider to walk through a realistic scenario: adding a student, processing a refund, changing a staff role or exporting a report. Include the people who will use the system every day, and ask what happens when data is missing or a connection fails. Understand the full cost of ownership Compare the initial project cost with recurring hosting, licences, messaging, payment fees and maintenance. Check what is included in support and what becomes a separate change request. A transparent proposal should help you understand both your launch budget and your ongoing commitment. Agree on ownership and exit Clarify source-code licensing, administrative access, account ownership and data export before signing. Ask how you would move your data or hand maintenance to another provider. These questions make the working relationship clearer from the beginning. Put your idea into words. Create a project brief START A PROJECT Let’s build your next system. Talk to us Project planner

## What a useful software maintenance plan includes
URL: https://subromart.com/resources/software-maintenance-guide/

Operations What a useful software maintenance plan includes Know what to ask about updates, backups, incidents and support responsibilities. Subromart editorial Meet our founder 1 min read In this guide Know what is being maintained Backups need a restore plan Define support coverage clearly Make room for ongoing improvement Know what is being maintained Start with an inventory of applications, servers, domains, third-party services and administrative accounts. Identify who owns each part and who can access it. A maintenance provider needs enough context to make changes responsibly and avoid surprises. Backups need a restore plan A backup is only useful if the team knows how to restore it. Agree what data is backed up, where it is stored, how long it is retained and how restore checks are performed. Define recovery expectations in terms your business understands. Define support coverage clearly Document support hours, communication channels, severity levels and response targets. Response time is different from resolution time. Ask how incidents are escalated and how you will be kept informed while the issue is being investigated. Make room for ongoing improvement Routine fixes and new features are different kinds of work. Keep a shared backlog, review recurring problems and agree how improvements are estimated and prioritised. A short, regular review helps the system stay aligned with your business. Put your idea into words. Create a project brief START A PROJECT Let’s build your next system. Talk to us Project planner

## Before you build an app: a founder’s checklist
URL: https://subromart.com/resources/planning-your-app/

Product planning Before you build an app: a founder’s checklist Turn a promising idea into a clear brief your development team can act on. Subromart editorial Meet our founder 1 min read In this guide Name the person and the problem Choose the smallest useful release List operational dependencies Plan the day after launch Name the person and the problem Be specific about who the app helps and the problem it solves. Describe the current workaround and why it falls short. Your first audience does not need to be everyone; a focused initial group makes it easier to decide what belongs in the first release. Choose the smallest useful release Map the essential user journey from entry to a completed task. Build the features needed for that journey first. Defer optional dashboards, complex rewards and additional user types until the core experience is useful and reviewable. List operational dependencies An app may need payment accounts, map services, SMS providers, video hosting, content and store accounts. Identify the owner of each dependency early. Availability, usage limits and recurring costs can affect both the timeline and the architecture. Plan the day after launch Decide who answers customer questions, manages content, reviews problems and approves updates. A launch is a transition into operations. Including these responsibilities in the brief makes the product easier to run as real users arrive. Put your idea into words. Create a project brief START A PROJECT Let’s build your next system. Talk to us Project planner

## E-commerce website checklist for Bangladesh
URL: https://subromart.com/resources/ecommerce-website-checklist/

E-commerce planning E-commerce website checklist for Bangladesh Plan products, checkout, payments, delivery and store management before building your e-commerce website. A practical checklist from Subromart. Subromart editorial Meet our founder 1 min read In this guide Start with what you sell Map checkout and payments Connect orders to operations Test the complete mobile journey Agree ownership and ongoing costs Start with what you sell Physical products need stock, variants and delivery. Digital products need access rules, download delivery or course access. List these workflows first so you can compare proposals for the same scope. Map checkout and payments Decide on guest checkout, customer accounts, cash on delivery and online payment options. Confirm payment-provider onboarding and charges directly with the provider. Include failed payments, duplicate callbacks and order confirmation in the test plan. Connect orders to operations Specify who updates stock, confirms orders and handles returns. Plan delivery areas, courier integration and order status messages. Your team should be able to follow one order from checkout through fulfilment. Test the complete mobile journey Review a real product, variant selection, checkout and confirmation on a phone. Include slow connections, empty stock and cancellation. Use clear product descriptions, useful images and crawlable product URLs so shoppers and search engines can understand the catalogue. Agree ownership and ongoing costs Record domain, hosting, data export, licence rights and support responsibilities. Ask which recurring costs sit outside the development quote. Use the client-care checklist before confirming your project. Explore e-commerce development Download the project checklist Put your idea into words. Create a project brief START A PROJECT Let’s build your next system. Talk to us Project planner
